name: bowire-vscode
description: The Bowire multi-protocol API workbench, hosted in VS Code. gRPC, REST, GraphQL, SignalR, MQTT, WebSocket, SSE, MCP and more — with collections and environments stored in the workspace so they travel with the repo.

bowire.cliPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `bowire` executable. Leave empty to search `PATH`. Supports `${workspaceFolder}`, so a project-local build can be committed to `.vscode/settings.json` and shared with the team.
